tests.procedure: Weigh 100 mg of sample in a stopper tube, add solvent in steps (0.1 mL, 0.9 mL, 2 mL, 7 mL; then 10 mg/10 mL, 1 mg/10 mL) shaking 1 min and maintaining 25.0 ± 0.5 °C for 15 min at each step to classify solubility.

tests.procedure: Identification by HPLC: Run the sample solution alongside working standard solution using the assay chromatographic conditions. The principal peak in the test solution chromatogram corresponds in retention time to the principal peak in the reference solution chromatogram.

tests.source: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)500 IUmg)__STM Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)500 IUmg) Micro 2-0.txt:32

tests.procedure: Accurately weigh empty weighing bottle dried at 80 °C (W0). Weigh accurately 1.000 g into weighing bottle (W1). Dry in calibrated oven at 80 °C for 2 h, cool in desiccator, weigh (W2). Repeat to constant weight. % Loss on Drying = (W1 - W2) / (W1 - W0) x 100.

details.formula: % Loss on Drying = (W1 - W2) / (W1 - W0) x 100
details.reference: BP 2024 Appendix IX D. Determination of Loss on Drying; Analytical Method Verification Loss on drying in Vitamin D3 (500IU/mg)

tests.source: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)500 IUmg)__STM Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)500 IUmg) Micro 2-0.txt:33

tests.procedure: HPLC assay: Standard: 20 mg Vitamin D3 (500 IU/mg) working standard in 100 mL flask, add ~20 mL water, shake 1 min, sonicate 10 min, dilute to volume with methanol, sonicate 5 min; dilute 5 mL to 100 mL with methanol. Sample: 20 mg sample prepared identically. Column: BDS C18, 5 µm, 150 x 4.6 mm. Mobile phase: 96% methanol HPLC Grade. Flow rate: 1.5 mL/min. Wavelength: 265 nm. Column temp: 35 °C. Injection: 100 µL. Run time: 8 min. Assay % = (PAt / PAst) x (Act.Wt.std / Theo.Wt.std) x (Theo.Wt.test / Act.Wt.test) x Potency.

details.standardPrep: 20 mg working standard in 100 mL (water/methanol), dilute 5 mL to 100 mL with methanol
details.samplePrep: 20 mg sample in 100 mL (water/methanol), dilute 5 mL to 100 mL with methanol
details.reference: Analytical Method Validation for Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)

tests.procedure: Test for E. coli per USP <2022> / <2023>: Pre-enrichment in SCDB at 30-35 °C 24-48 h; 1 mL to 10 mL MacConkey Broth at 42-44 °C 24-48 h; subculture on MacConkey Agar at 30-35 °C 18-24 h; confirm brick-red colonies by Gram stain, EMB agar, TBX agar, or biochemical identification.
